correctness.rationale: Nonsingular Q and six transverse rational base points establish A1 node and blowup. Divisor classes enumerate six nodal and 15 nonnodal lines. Actual chart calculations give rank3 with nonzero quadratic obstruction at node and rank4 otherwise; local lengths 2 and 1 follow. Generic degree27 plus special length27 gives finite flatness over DVR. The blowup and exceptional conic produce q²+6q+1 for every q=5^m, with point counts q5=56 and q25=776 directly checked. Limitations: not an arbitrary cubic integral model; direct enumerations are corroborative.

value.rationale: Explicit Fano-scheme degeneration at the distinguished bad-reduction prime of the maximally symmetric classical Clebsch cubic is structurally motivated: 27 generic lines specialize to 21 supports with six doubled Fano points, all rational because the blowup points exhaust the F5-points of a smooth conic. The all-extension zeta follows and records the Frobenius-split geometry. This package is a natural arithmetic-geometric classification, not an arbitrary narrow statistic.
